# Vendored: community skills

Two community skills George picked from the LobeHub skills marketplace (2026-09-18), vendored
**byte-verbatim** from their GitHub sources, licences alongside. Do not edit them here; re-vendor
to update (fetch, copy, bump this header). The NeuraMesh adaptation is the `prose` preamble in
`scripts/marketing-os-manifest.ts`, which `scripts/gen-marketing-os-seed.ts` composes in front of
the verbatim text (the same contract as `vendor/marketing-os`).

## content-creator

Source: https://github.com/Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps (Apache-2.0, the skill's own frontmatter
says MIT), `awesome_agent_skills/content-creator/SKILL.md` at
`ca3a3d37438643fd47b1dac095c2ce9cca92ef72`. Upstream removed the file on 2026-07-08 in
"chore: remove 19 basic prompt-dump skills" (`26f859f44bca`); the marketplace still lists it at
https://lobehub.com/skills/shubhamsaboo-awesome-llm-apps-content-creator. It is a plain writing
frame (audience, hook, value, scannable, action, and platform templates); the preamble and the
de-slop pass are what make it land here.
